lineRefsAt: file:line references are to the baseline commit unless marked (now)

statusMeaning.fixed: code changed; every listed regression test must exist and pass (checked by scripts/audit-report.ts)
statusMeaning.fixed_untested: code changed; no automated test (stated, not hidden)
statusMeaning.documented: not changed in code; the limitation is now stated where a reader meets it
statusMeaning.refuted: reported by a reviewer, disproved on inspection; no change

findings.title: A re-observed version that changes live rows published no event
findings.rootCause: intake.records_stored was gated on inserted > 0 || conflicts > 0; a duplicate of a received-clock record re-projected (A → B → A) is neither, so reconciliation never learned the payment flipped back.
findings.fix: projectAll returns rows actually written (upsert rowCount); ingest also publishes when re-observed projections changed a row. An unchanged re-read still publishes nothing.
findings.redGreen: fails on baseline (no event, consumer idle), passes after

findings.title: A direct lead-branch override never woke the identity consumer
findings.rootCause: overrideLeadBranchInTransaction reconciled inline but published nothing; identity reads v_leads.effective_branch_id, so prospects kept the old branch.
findings.fix: Publish action_center.lead_branch_overridden before the inline reconcile; identity triggers on it.
findings.redGreen: fails on baseline (0 events), passes after

findings.title: drainJobs dropped a kick that arrived during its final dispatch
findings.rootCause: state.again was only re-read inside the job loop; a kick during the min(next_attempt_at) query or the end-of-drain dispatchEvents returned at once and was never followed up.
findings.fix: The whole round, dispatch included, repeats while a kick is pending (bounded by MAX_DRAIN_MS).

tests.name: B-2: a kick that arrives while the drain dispatches events is not lost

findings.redGreen: fails on baseline (job stays queued), passes after

findings.title: The drain spun every 50 ms for up to 10 minutes on a job another process's stream blocked
findings.rootCause: min(next_attempt_at) counted queued jobs that claimNext refuses while their stream is running elsewhere; wait was negative so neither break fired.
findings.fix: The wait query excludes jobs whose stream has a running job, matching the claim predicate.

tests.name: B-3: a due job whose stream another process is running does not keep the drain spinning

findings.redGreen: fails on baseline (still spinning after 5 s), passes after

findings.title: A sync request that only reused queued jobs was not idempotent by its key
findings.rootCause: Idempotency was looked up through sync_jobs.request_key; a request that created no row recorded no key.
findings.fix: Migration 0011 adds sync_requests (key, fingerprint, job ids); replays are answered from it, a different request under the key is 409.
findings.redGreen: fails on baseline (alreadyRequested false), passes after

findings.title: Unmapped spend could never block a budget signal
findings.rootCause: unmapped_spend exceptions always have branch_id null; budgetSignal filtered branch_id = $1 and decisionHolds branch_id is not null, so the kind listed as blocking matched nothing. B44 read trustworthy while its Local Services cost was understated by $4,539 of unallocated spend.
findings.fix: An open unmapped-spend exception blocks each branch whose completed acquisitions its campaign produced, in the compared channel and period; the Overview holds list includes it per affected branch.
findings.numbersChanged: B44's October budget signal becomes not trustworthy; B44 appears in decision holds. No number in docs/interview-demo.md changes; B09 is not affected (asserted).
findings.redGreen: fails on baseline (B44 trustworthy), passes after

findings.title: Branch paid CAC: spend and customers use different branch keys
findings.rootCause: Spend follows the campaign's mapped (marketing) branch; customers follow the CRM office that services them. 9 October customers differ (B06/B07).
findings.fix: Not changed: which branch owns CAC is a business decision, and re-keying paid customers would split them from the branch's other customer counts. Stated in docs/metric-definitions.md (Paid-media CAC).

findings.title: Paid CAC denominator included customers whose spend the numerator excludes
findings.rootCause: Numerator: media spend on mapped campaigns. Denominator: every is_paid channel, including sponsorship (not media) and customers credited to unmapped campaigns.
findings.fix: paid_acquired counts paid media customers not credited to an unmapped campaign.
findings.numbersChanged: October company paid customers 1,727 → 1,725 (two B44 customers of the unmapped campaign); company paid CAC still displays $267; B20/B09 unchanged. Golden snapshot regenerated.
findings.redGreen: fails on baseline (2 vs 1), passes after

findings.title: Payload conflicts had no branch and no customer
findings.rootCause: The conflict exception was inserted with branch_id null and no customer_ids, contradicting the definition that untied revenue includes conflicting payloads; branch viewers could not see them.
findings.fix: Branch from payload_branch(stored payload), customer from its customerID.
findings.numbersChanged: Company revenue in open exceptions (untied) rises by the collected revenue of the 3 seeded conflict customers (reviewer measured $269). Not quoted in the demo script.
findings.redGreen: fails on baseline (branch null), passes after

findings.title: channel_conflict fired for any non-D2D first touch, not only a paid one
findings.rootCause: The view checked channel_code <> 'd2d'; the definition says a paid touch.
findings.fix: Migration 0012 replaces v_acquisitions with an is_paid check (same columns).
findings.numbersChanged: None in the seed (0 such rows).
findings.redGreen: fails without migration 0012, passes with it

findings.title: Coverage-gap reference date is global, not per feed
findings.rootCause: Reviewer assumed one feed per ad platform. Every platform arrives through the single 'ads' stream (ingestion_runs: one stream), so the global latest spend date IS the feed's own date.
findings.fix: None. Revisit if platforms move to separate streams.

findings.title: reporting.fact_acquisitions_v1 grain mislabelled as acquired customers
findings.rootCause: The view is one row per new customer (first subscription); acquired is a filter on it. The contract test summed it unfiltered and passed only because fixtures were all serviced.
findings.fix: Migration 0012 replaces contract_v1 with the true grain; doc corrected; the contract test now filters to completed-in-period.

tests.name: facts agree with the app's own metrics

findings.redGreen: grain assertion fails without migration 0012

findings.title: Two stopped campaigns in one ad account doubled the coverage-gap amount
findings.rootCause: Successors were joined per predecessor and grouped without the predecessor id, so a successor's spend was summed once per predecessor in the account.
findings.fix: Successors are joined per (branch, channel, gap, ad account) with the predecessor ids excluded.

tests.name: two stopped campaigns in one ad account do not double the successor's spend

findings.numbersChanged: None in the seed (one campaign per branch, channel and account).
findings.redGreen: fails on baseline (360000 vs 180000), passes after

findings.title: POST /api/role worked in any production build
findings.rootCause: The 'production removes /api/role' promise in lib/viewer.ts was not enforced; anyone could become approver on a deployed copy.
findings.fix: lib/demo-mode.ts: outside development/tests a build needs DEMO_MODE=1; otherwise the role cookie is ignored (guest) and /api/role is 404. Playwright sets the flag.

tests.name: POST /api/role refuses in a production build
is on in development and tests

findings.redGreen: fails on baseline (200 + cookie), passes after

findings.title: The incident page named the branch of an out-of-scope exception
findings.rootCause: It rendered 'cannot view exceptions for B07' while the API, customer and investigation pages treat out of scope as missing.
findings.fix: notFound() for out-of-scope exceptions.

tests.name: an out-of-scope incident reads as missing

findings.title: The FieldRoutes mock served every office unscoped in any build
findings.rootCause: No production guard; demo keys are published in the source.
findings.fix: Served only in demo mode (lib/demo-mode.ts).

tests.name: the FieldRoutes mock is not served by a production build

findings.redGreen: fails on baseline, passes after

findings.title: Cancelled plans were planned as Data Manager retractions, which Data Manager does not support
findings.rootCause: Retraction semantics of the legacy Google Ads API were carried to Data Manager (its upgrade guide: no conversion retractions). No ledger records what was sent.
findings.fix: Decision renamed suppress_cancelled ('Don't send: plan cancelled'); no event body is built for non-upload rows; docs corrected.
findings.numbersChanged: Snapshot key 'retract' renamed 'suppress_cancelled' (value 0 in the seed).
findings.redGreen: fails on baseline ('retract'), passes after

findings.title: 'Not matchable: no click id' was false
findings.rootCause: Google matches on hashed email/phone (enhanced conversions for leads) and gbraid/wbraid; neither is implemented here.
findings.fix: Label says 'No click id (hashed-identity matching not built)'; page and docs explain, including that stored hashes are not in Google's format.

tests.name: a row without a gclid is labelled as not built

findings.title: Click age measured from the lead time with a hard-coded 90 days
findings.rootCause: leads.occurred_at is at or after the click; Google's limit is the conversion action's click-through window.
findings.fix: Kept the rule (changing it would move the demo's reportable counts); relabelled 'Too old: lead > 90 days ago', column renamed Lead, limitation stated on the page and in the definitions.

tests.name: a row without a gclid is labelled as not built

findings.title: A 30-minute overlap lost records across the autumn clock change
findings.rootCause: FieldRoutes filters on zone-less wall time; in the repeated hour a record (06:40Z Chicago = 01:40) fell after window 1's wall end (01:20) and before window 2's wall start (01:50).
findings.fix: wallWindow() widens a window that crosses an offset change by the size of the shift on both sides.

tests.name: a record in the repeated hour is read by one of two overlapping windows
every minute of the transition day is inside some window

findings.redGreen: both fail with the shift forced to 0 (baseline behaviour), pass after

findings.title: Rate-limit retries gave up inside the same minute when no Retry-After was sent
findings.rootCause: FieldRoutes documents no Retry-After; exponential backoff alone spent five attempts in ~30 s, inside a 60/min window. The mock always sent the header, hiding it.
findings.fix: A 429 without Retry-After waits at least 60 s.
findings.redGreen: fails on baseline (750 ms), passes after

findings.title: A non-office wire time zone changed the search windows but not the mapper
findings.rootCause: Setting wireTimeZone=America/Los_Angeles (as the README advised for a real tenant) would make windows right and stored instants wrong, silently.
findings.fix: The config refuses any wireTimeZone but 'office' until the mapper converts with the connector zone. Mapper deviations G1–G10 remain open and documented.

tests.name: refuses a wire time zone the mapper does not use

findings.redGreen: fails on baseline (accepted), passes after

findings.title: Deletes and merges are never detected
findings.rootCause: Soft-deleted customers drop out of office-scoped searches; hard-deleted records stay in projections. No periodic id-set diff.
findings.fix: Not built: needs a full id-set diff and tombstones. Stated in lib/connectors/README.md.

findings.title: Late payment status changes older than the 35-day sweep are missed
findings.rootCause: Payments are re-read by date over 35 days; a void/dispute/ACH return on an older payment is never seen. A payment dateUpdated is unconfirmed (research/17 §3).
findings.fix: Not built; needs confirmation on an authorized tenant. Stated in lib/connectors/README.md.

findings.title: Record keys could close the <tool_output> delimiter
findings.rootCause: Tag characters were escaped in the JSON body only; the warning note after the element was built from object keys, which a source chooses (redaction rewrites values, not keys).
findings.fix: Warning paths get the same escaping.
findings.redGreen: fails on baseline (two </tool_output>), passes after

findings.title: A failed model run was labelled 'no model configured'
findings.rootCause: No fallback label existed; a configured, billed model that failed was reported as absent. The existing test asserted the misleading label.
findings.fix: fallbackModeLabel(reason): 'Deterministic fallback — the model run failed (…)'. The existing assertion was strengthened to require it (not weakened).

tests.name: a model that never submits hits the turn budget

findings.title: getSourceLineage 'versions' leaked other branches' raw-event ids into grounding
findings.rootCause: Versions were looked up by (source, entity, entity_id) with no scope check, and every unidentifiable record shares entity_id 'unidentified'.
findings.fix: No versions for 'unidentified'; every version is scope-checked.
findings.redGreen: fails on baseline, passes after

findings.title: compareMappingVersions confirmed an out-of-scope raw event's existence and source
findings.rootCause: The source check ran before the scope check.
findings.fix: Scope first.
findings.redGreen: fails on baseline, passes after

findings.title: An engineer could re-map or replay with no approval, from the incident page
findings.rootCause: The legacy direct-replay path was never retired when propose → approve → execute was added.
findings.fix: POST /api/replays is dry-run only (409 on a commit); the panel previews and points to the Action Center. The legacy browser tests that committed through the panel now assert the refusal and apply the same fix through approval.

findings.title: The ChangeGuard demo script walked the bypass path and quoted unasserted numbers
findings.rootCause: Script predated the Action Center; 'sound' is not UI copy; 8.6×, 2.9×, $2,124 and 45 were asserted nowhere.
findings.fix: Script rewritten as the four-minute path; every quoted number is in tests/fixtures/b09-golden.json and asserted in the browser.

findings.title: scripts/screenshots.ts targeted a removed test id and never closed the browser
findings.rootCause: /exceptions renders case-queue now; main() was not awaited or caught.
findings.fix: case-queue / replay-panel selectors; browser closed in finally; exit 1 on error. Not executed in this audit.

findings.title: A customers page past the end reported zero customers
findings.rootCause: total was read from the returned rows.
findings.fix: Total counted independently; a past-the-end page says so and links to the last page.

tests.name: a customers page past the end says so

findings.title: The Action Center queue silently stopped at 200 rows
findings.rootCause: listQueue's default limit with no paging; the title showed rows.length.
findings.fix: 50 per page with offset, countQueue total, 'Showing x–y of N'.

findings.title: Audit subject links matched by prefix; the log had no paging
findings.rootCause: subject like $3 || '%' with no escaping; fixed 100-row cap.
findings.fix: Exact match for id-bearing subjects, escaped prefix for bare types; keyset paging on (at, id).

findings.title: Query parameters accepted built-in object keys (?period=toString crashed the page)
findings.rootCause: `key in OBJECT` walks the prototype.
findings.fix: Object.hasOwn.

findings.title: Accessibility: status/focus lost after Execute, focus dropped by disabled busy controls, command menu not a combobox, chart data hidden, diff tables without row headers, skeletons not announced
findings.rootCause: See the per-item notes in docs/audit/2026-11-09/report.md.
findings.fix: Always-mounted polite status region and focus to the result; aria-disabled while busy; combobox wiring and focus return; sr-only data table; th scope=row with sr-only changed/unchanged; role=status skeleton.

findings.title: Three e2e reliability risks (60 s wait = test timeout, positional selector, search-cap order dependence)
findings.rootCause: Timing and order assumptions in the specs.
findings.fix: 120 s test timeout for that test only; header-based locator; a specific search term. No assertion weakened.

findings.title: Reseeding while the server dispatches events logs 'relation domain_events does not exist'
findings.rootCause: The browser tests drop and rebuild the demo schema while the running server's after() dispatch is in flight; the consumer records the failure and retries on the next dispatch. Test-harness only; the seed never runs against a serving production database.
findings.fix: None needed for correctness (the failure is recorded and retried). Observed in the baseline e2e log.

findings.title: Channel rows tied on customer count came back in a different order between runs
findings.rootCause: order by is_paid, acquired had no tie-breaker; Postgres may return ties in any order. Found while regenerating the ChangeGuard golden snapshot: Meta and Microsoft (5 customers each) swapped.
findings.fix: channel code as the last sort key. Verified by regenerating docs/changeguard/snapshot.json: identical to the pre-audit file apart from generatedBy/demoNow. No automated test.
